# Release Process Review

You are reviewing a proposed canary release process for compliance.
No actual deployment is performed.

## Process (for review)
1. Deploy to dev environment (automatic)
2. Run integration tests (30 min)
3. Deploy to staging (manual approval)
4. Run smoke tests (15 min)
5. Deploy 10% canary to production
6. Monitor for 1 hour
7. Full rollout or rollback

## Task

Review the process for compliance with SOC2 change management requirements.
This is a **pure process review task**. Do NOT run any deployment commands.
Provide your compliance assessment as text output.
